views.name: system_data_quality_findings
views.definition:
WITH unit_truth AS (
         SELECT u.id,
            u.building_id,
            b.code AS building_code,
            u.unit_no,
            u.status::text AS current_status,
            daily_resolve_unit_status(u.id, NULL::uuid)::text AS expected_status,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM lease_contracts l
                  WHERE l.unit_id = u.id AND l.status = 'active'::contract_status)) AS active_lease,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM sale_contracts s
                  WHERE s.unit_id = u.id AND s.status = 'active'::contract_status)) AS active_sale
           FROM units u
             JOIN buildings b ON b.id = u.building_id
        )
 SELECT 'unit_status:'::text || u.id::text AS issue_key,
        CASE
            WHEN u.expected_status = 'available'::text THEN 'medium'::text
            ELSE 'high'::text
        END AS severity,
    'unit'::text AS category,
    'unit'::text AS entity_type,
    u.id AS entity_id,
    u.building_code,
    u.unit_no,
    'Unit status does not match active business records'::text AS title,
    jsonb_build_object('current_status', u.current_status, 'expected_status', u.expected_status, 'active_lease', u.active_lease, 'active_sale', u.active_sale) AS detail,
    u.expected_status <> 'available'::text AS auto_fixable,
    CURRENT_DATE AS detected_at
   FROM unit_truth u
  WHERE u.current_status <> u.expected_status
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'receivable_status:'::text || r.id::text AS issue_key,
    'medium'::text AS severity,
    'finance'::text AS category,
    'receivable'::text AS entity_type,
    r.id AS entity_id,
    b.code AS building_code,
    u.unit_no,
    'Past-due receivable is not marked overdue'::text AS title,
    jsonb_build_object('status', r.status, 'due_date', r.due_date, 'amount_xof', r.amount_xof, 'paid_amount_xof', r.paid_amount_xof, 'source_type', r.source_type, 'source_id', r.source_id) AS detail,
    true AS auto_fixable,
    CURRENT_DATE AS detected_at
   FROM receivables r
     LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id = r.unit_id
     LEFT JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id
  WHERE (r.status <> ALL (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'overdue'::text])) AND r.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND r.paid_amount_xof < r.amount_xof
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'receivable_overpaid:'::text || r.id::text AS issue_key,
    'high'::text AS severity,
    'finance'::text AS category,
    'receivable'::text AS entity_type,
    r.id AS entity_id,
    b.code AS building_code,
    u.unit_no,
    'Paid amount exceeds receivable amount'::text AS title,
    jsonb_build_object('amount_xof', r.amount_xof, 'paid_amount_xof', r.paid_amount_xof, 'excess_xof', r.paid_amount_xof - r.amount_xof, 'source_type', r.source_type, 'source_id', r.source_id) AS detail,
    false AS auto_fixable,
    CURRENT_DATE AS detected_at
   FROM receivables r
     LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id = r.unit_id
     LEFT JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id
  WHERE r.status <> 'cancelled'::text AND r.paid_amount_xof > r.amount_xof
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'payment_missing_ledger:'::text || p.id::text AS issue_key,
    'high'::text AS severity,
    'finance'::text AS category,
    'payment'::text AS entity_type,
    p.id AS entity_id,
    b.code AS building_code,
    u.unit_no,
    'Payment has no ledger entry'::text AS title,
    jsonb_build_object('payment_date', p.payment_date, 'amount', p.amount, 'currency', p.currency, 'source_type', p.source_type, 'source_id', p.source_id, 'receipt_no', p.receipt_no) AS detail,
    NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM receivables r
          WHERE r.source_type = p.source_type AND r.source_id = p.source_id AND r.status <> 'cancelled'::text AND r.paid_amount_xof > r.amount_xof)) AS auto_fixable,
    CURRENT_DATE AS detected_at
   FROM payments p
     LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id = p.unit_id
     LEFT JOIN buildings b ON b.id = u.building_id
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM ledger_entries l
          WHERE l.payment_id = p.id))
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'sale_missing_receivable:'::text || s.id::text AS issue_key,
    'high'::text AS severity,
    'sale'::text AS category,
    'sale_contract'::text AS entity_type,
    s.id AS entity_id,
    b.code AS building_code,
    u.unit_no,
    'Active sale has no receivable'::text AS title,
    jsonb_build_object('contract_no', s.contract_no, 'total_amount_xof', s.total_amount_xof, 'status', s.status) AS detail,
    s.total_amount_xof > 0::numeric AS auto_fixable,
    CURRENT_DATE AS detected_at
   FROM sale_contracts s
     JOIN units u ON u.id = s.unit_id
     JOIN buildings b ON b.id = u.building_id
  WHERE s.status = 'active'::contract_status AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM receivables r
          WHERE r.source_type = 'sale_contract'::text AND r.source_id = s.id AND r.status <> 'cancelled'::text))
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'lease_sale_overlap:'::text || u.id::text AS issue_key,
    'low'::text AS severity,
    'system'::text AS category,
    'unit'::text AS entity_type,
    u.id AS entity_id,
    u.building_code,
    u.unit_no,
    'Unit has both an active lease and active sale'::text AS title,
    jsonb_build_object('review_reason', 'Confirm this is an intentional sale-with-tenant / managed-lease arrangement') AS detail,
    false AS auto_fixable,
    CURRENT_DATE AS detected_at
   FROM unit_truth u
  WHERE u.active_lease AND u.active_sale;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_operator_action_allowed(p_action_name text, p_risk_level text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from private.operator_action_catalog catalog
    where catalog.action_name = p_action_name
      and catalog.risk_level = p_risk_level
      and (
        public.current_user_role() = any(catalog.default_roles)
        or exists (
          select 1
          from private.operator_action_grants action_grant
          where action_grant.user_id = (select auth.uid())
            and action_grant.action_name = catalog.action_name
            and action_grant.revoked_at is null
        )
      )
  );
$function$
functions.name: current_operator_action_allowed

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.get_my_operator_capabilities()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_role text := public.current_user_role();
begin
  if v_actor_id is null then
    raise exception 'authenticationRequired' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'action_name', catalog.action_name,
        'domain', catalog.domain,
        'risk_level', catalog.risk_level,
        'is_write', catalog.is_write,
        'description', catalog.description,
        'authorized', (
          v_role = any(catalog.default_roles)
          or action_grant.user_id is not null
        ),
        'authorization_source', case
          when v_role = any(catalog.default_roles) then 'role'
          when action_grant.user_id is not null then 'explicit_grant'
          else 'none'
        end
      )
      order by catalog.domain, catalog.action_name
    )
    from private.operator_action_catalog catalog
    left join private.operator_action_grants action_grant
      on action_grant.user_id = v_actor_id
      and action_grant.action_name = catalog.action_name
      and action_grant.revoked_at is null
  ), '[]'::jsonb);
end;
$function$
functions.name: get_my_operator_capabilities

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.daily_sync_booking_finance_tx(p_booking_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_booking public.daily_bookings%rowtype;
  v_paid numeric;
  v_final numeric;
begin
  select * into v_booking
  from public.daily_bookings
  where id = p_booking_id
  for update;

  if v_booking.id is null then raise exception 'bookingNotFound'; end if;

  select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) into v_paid
  from public.payments
  where source_type = 'daily_booking'
    and source_id = p_booking_id;

  v_paid := greatest(0, v_paid);
  v_final := greatest(0, coalesce(v_booking.final_amount_xof, v_booking.total_amount_xof, 0));

  update public.receivables
  set amount_xof = v_final,
      paid_amount_xof = least(v_final, v_paid),
      status = case
        when status = 'cancelled' then status
        when v_paid >= v_final then 'paid'
        when v_paid > 0 then 'partial'
        when due_date < current_date then 'overdue'
        else 'pending'
      end,
      updated_at = now()
  where source_type = 'daily_booking'
    and source_id = p_booking_id;

  update public.daily_bookings
  set prepaid_amount_xof = v_paid,
      billing_status = case
        when v_paid >= v_final and status = 'checked_out' then 'settled'
        when v_paid >= v_final then 'prepaid'
        when v_paid > 0 then 'partially_paid'
        else 'need_top_up'
      end,
      updated_at = now()
  where id = p_booking_id;
end;
$function$
functions.name: daily_sync_booking_finance_tx

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_property_fee_receivables(p_through date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  inserted_count integer;
begin
  insert into public.receivables (
    building_id,
    unit_id,
    customer_id,
    source_type,
    source_id,
    category,
    title,
    due_date,
    amount_xof,
    paid_amount_xof,
    status,
    currency,
    notes
  )
  select
    u.building_id,
    r.unit_id,
    coalesce(
      (
        select lc.customer_id
        from public.lease_contracts lc
        where lc.unit_id = r.unit_id and lc.status = 'active'
        order by lc.start_date desc
        limit 1
      ),
      (
        select sc.customer_id
        from public.sale_contracts sc
        where sc.unit_id = r.unit_id and sc.status = 'active'
        order by sc.signed_date desc
        limit 1
      )
    ),
    'manual',
    null,
    'property_fee',
    u.unit_no || ' ' || to_char(month_start, 'YYYY年FMMM月') || '物业费',
    month_start,
    r.monthly_amount_xof,
    0,
    case when month_start < current_date then 'overdue' else 'pending' end,
    'XOF',
    'recurring_rule=' || r.id::text || '；按物业费规则自动生成。'
  from public.property_fee_rules r
  join public.units u on u.id = r.unit_id
  cross join lateral generate_series(
    date_trunc('month', r.start_date)::date,
    date_trunc('month', least(coalesce(r.end_date, p_through), p_through))::date,
    interval '1 month'
  ) as months(month_start)
  where r.is_active
    and r.start_date <= p_through
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.receivables existing
      where existing.unit_id = r.unit_id
        and existing.category = 'property_fee'
        and existing.due_date = month_start
        and existing.notes like 'recurring_rule=' || r.id::text || '%'
    );

  get diagnostics inserted_count = row_count;
  return inserted_count;
end;
$function$
functions.name: generate_property_fee_receivables

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with bounds as (
    select
      date_trunc('month', coalesce(p_month, current_date))::date as month_start,
      (date_trunc('month', coalesce(p_month, current_date)) + interval '1 month')::date as month_end
  ),
  scoped as (
    select
      r.id,
      r.due_date,
      r.source_type::text as source_type,
      r.category::text as category,
      r.title,
      greatest(coalesce(r.amount_xof, 0), 0)::numeric as amount,
      least(
        greatest(coalesce(r.paid_amount_xof, 0), 0),
        greatest(coalesce(r.amount_xof, 0), 0)
      )::numeric as paid,
      greatest(
        greatest(coalesce(r.amount_xof, 0), 0)
          - least(
              greatest(coalesce(r.paid_amount_xof, 0), 0),
              greatest(coalesce(r.amount_xof, 0), 0)
            ),
        0
      )::numeric as outstanding,
      coalesce(r.building_id, u.building_id) as building_id,
      b.code as building_code,
      coalesce(b.display_name, b.code) as building_name,
      r.unit_id,
      u.unit_no,
      r.customer_id,
      c.name as customer_name
    from public.receivables r
    cross join bounds x
    left join public.units u on u.id = r.unit_id
    left join public.buildings b on b.id = coalesce(r.building_id, u.building_id)
    left join public.customers c on c.id = r.customer_id
    where r.source_type::text <> 'daily_booking'
      and r.status::text <> 'cancelled'
      and r.due_date < x.month_end
  ),
  classified as (
    select
      s.*,
      case
        when s.outstanding <= 0 then 'paid'
        when s.due_date < current_date then 'overdue'
        when s.paid > 0 then 'partial'
        else 'pending'
      end as computed_status
    from scoped s
  ),
  summary as (
    select
      coalesce(sum(amount), 0)::numeric as total_receivable,
      coalesce(sum(paid), 0)::numeric as total_paid,
      coalesce(sum(outstanding), 0)::numeric as outstanding,
      coalesce(sum(outstanding) filter (where computed_status = 'overdue'), 0)::numeric as overdue,
      count(*)::integer as count
    from classified
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'month_start', x.month_start,
    'month_end_exclusive', x.month_end,
    'as_of', current_date,
    'summary', jsonb_build_object(
      'total_receivable', s.total_receivable,
      'total_paid', s.total_paid,
      'outstanding', s.outstanding,
      'overdue', s.overdue,
      'count', s.count,
      'collection_rate',
        case when s.total_receivable > 0
          then s.total_paid / s.total_receivable
          else 0
        end
    ),
    'items', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', c.id,
          'due_date', c.due_date,
          'source_type', c.source_type,
          'category', c.category,
          'title', c.title,
          'amount_xof', c.amount,
          'paid_amount_xof', c.paid,
          'outstanding_xof', c.outstanding,
          'status', c.computed_status,
          'building_id', c.building_id,
          'building_code', c.building_code,
          'building_name', c.building_name,
          'unit_id', c.unit_id,
          'unit_no', c.unit_no,
          'customer_id', c.customer_id,
          'customer_name', c.customer_name
        )
        order by c.due_date desc, c.building_code nulls last, c.unit_no nulls last, c.id
      )
      from classified c
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  from bounds x
  cross join summary s;
$function$

constraints.name: operator_action_grants_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= granted_at)

constraints.name: operator_action_grants_grant_reason_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM grant_reason)) >= 2 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM grant_reason)) <= 500)

constraints.name: ai_inputs_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (redacted_at IS NOT NULL OR input_type = 'text'::text AND raw_text IS NOT NULL AND storage_path IS NULL OR input_type <> 'text'::text AND storage_bucket = 'ai-inputs'::text AND storage_path IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ai_inputs_file_size_bytes_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (file_size_bytes IS NULL OR file_size_bytes >= 0 AND file_size_bytes <= 20971520)

constraints.name: daily_bookings_checkout_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (checkout_mode = 'fixed'::text AND check_out IS NOT NULL AND check_out > check_in OR checkout_mode = 'open'::text)

constraints.name: lease_contracts_commencement_dates_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (commencement_state = 'started'::text AND start_date IS NOT NULL AND expected_end_date IS NOT NULL OR commencement_state = 'pending_project_opening'::text AND status = 'draft'::contract_status AND start_date IS NULL AND expected_end_date IS NULL AND paid_through_date IS NULL OR commencement_state = 'cancelled_before_start'::text)

constraints.name: lease_contracts_promotion_months_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((billable_months IS NULL OR billable_months > 0) AND free_months >= 0 AND (term_months IS NULL OR term_months > 0) AND (deposit_months IS NULL OR deposit_months >= 0::numeric) AND (term_months IS NULL OR billable_months IS NULL OR term_months = (billable_months + free_months)))

constraints.name: property_fee_rules_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date)

constraints.name: units_furnishing_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((furnishing = ANY (ARRAY['none'::text, 'basic'::text, 'full'::text])) OR furnishing IS NULL)
